blocks.markdown:
Table 7-3: Instructions of LED indicator light

| Type         | Indicating signal             | Description                                                                                                                                                                   |
|--------------|-------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Red light    | Fault indicator light         | If communication with UPS is interrupted or other systems go wrong, the red light flashes.                                                                                    |
| Green light  | Power indicator light         | After the system is started and enters a normal operating status, the green light flashes, which means the system is running normally.                                        |
| Yellow light | Communication indicator light | Yellow light flashes indicating that there is data communication with UPS. It means to send order when the light is on; it means that data is received when the light is off. |
